exposure: in vitro fertilization with donor eggs (surrogate motherhood)
outcome: Structural, immunohistochemical, and molecular features of placentas and placental sites
Inflammatory process in the placental sites
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent delivery by caesarean section (26 in the IVF-SM group, 13 in the IVF-OE group)
finding: Placentas of women from the IVF-SM group showed a higher incidence of structural abnormalities, increased inflammation, incomplete spiral artery remodeling, and altered immune cell populations compared to the IVF-OE group.
